text: You are purely unbelievable.
What do you think you're doing here?
I work here, Detective.
I'm not trespassing. I just happened to leave some notes on Tom's desk.
That's a load of shit, Craig.
You're not just a creep. You're a really bad liar.
Now tell me what the hell you're doing here before I arrest you.
Fine.
I'm trying to find out who killed Bob and Tom.
My ass. Get out of here. Now.
Look, Detective, there's some kind of company conspiracy behind all this.
I think Wintec is experimenting on its employees with hallucinogenic drugs.
I think they've...
Do go on. It all sounds perfectly logical to me.
You're a real case, you know that?
You make Charles Manson sound reasonable.
Detective, you have to listen to me.
I don't have to listen to Dick!
If I find one shred of evidence on Ravel,
If I find one of your hairs, one of your goddamn cells, I'll have you flash-fried.
Are you deaf or stupid?
I mean, the company murdered my father.
They probably killed Bob and Tom.
What do you want to bet I'm next?
I won't say it again.
Get out.
Or would you rather I call the boys with the white coats and the butterfly nets?
Come back, Curtis.
You know you're longing for the sting of the needle.
The burn of the electrodes on your skin.
